title: Features rise, fall, come back
description: ● shipped · ○ reworked · dashed = dormant years · line runs on if it's still alive today

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered feature columns with shipped/reworked events and explicit survival state. Years must be safe integers within the caller window. An incomplete feature timeline is unavailable; repeated names remain distinct.

props.name: years
props.description: Inclusive caller-owned year window. Years must be ordered safe integers. No current date or specimen window is inferred.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
